query: what documents are required for a home loan

payload.answer:
For a home loan application, you will need the following documents:

1. KYC Documents (all applicants)  
 • Aadhaar Card (for e-KYC)  
 • PAN Card  
 • One address proof (Passport, Voter ID or Driving License)  
 • Two passport-size photographs  

2. Income Proof  
 • For salaried applicants:  
   – Last 3 months’ salary slips  
   – Last 2 years’ Form 16 or ITR acknowledgements  
   – Last 6 months’ bank statements of salary account  
   – Appointment/employment confirmation letter  
 • For self-employed applicants:  
   – Last 3 years’ ITR with CA computation  
   – Last 3 years’ audited P&L and Balance Sheet  
   – GST registration and last 12 months’ GST returns  
   – Last 12 months’ current-account bank statements  
   – Business registration proof (Udyam/Shop Act/COI)  

3. Property Documents  
 • Agreement for Sale or Sale Deed/Allotment Letter  
 • Title Deed/Chain of Title documents (minimum 13 years)  
 • Approved building plan and Occupancy Certificate  
 • Latest property tax receipts  
 • NOC from housing society or builder  
 • Encumbrance Certificate for the last 13 years

payload.answer:
Here’s the typical end-to-end home-loan application journey and turnaround times:

1. Submit application and documents (online or at branch)  
   • Timeline: Day 1  
2. Document verification and CIBIL score check  
   • Timeline: 1–2 days  
3. Legal verification of property title and documents  
   • Timeline: 3–5 days  
4. Technical valuation of the property by a bank-empanelled valuer  
   • Timeline: 2–3 days  
5. Credit appraisal and sanction decision by the bank’s credit committee  
   • Timeline: 2–3 days  
6. Issuance of sanction letter to the applicant  
   • Timeline: Day 8–12  
7. Acceptance of sanction terms by borrower and execution of the MODT (Memorandum of Deposit of Title Deed)  
   • Timeline: 1–2 days  
8. Disbursement of funds (either in full or tranche-wise for under-construction properties)  
   • Timeline: Day 10–15 after application submission  

Overall, most home-loan applications complete disbursement within about 10–15 days, subject to document clarity and valuation.

query: how to take a home loan

payload.answer:
To apply for a home loan with us, you will typically follow these steps:

1. Check your eligibility  
   • Salaried: age 21–60 at maturity, minimum ₹25,000/month (metros) or ₹20,000 (non-metros), CIBIL ≥700  
   • Self-employed: age 25–65 at maturity, ≥3 years in business, ITR income ≥₹3 Lakh/year, CIBIL ≥700  

2. Gather documents  
   • Identity & address proof (PAN, Aadhaar, passport, utility bills)  
   • Income proof (salary slips + Form 16 for salaried; ITRs, audited P&L + balance sheet, bank statements for self-employed)  
   • Property papers (Agreement for Sale/Sale Deed, title deeds, approved plan & occupancy certificate, encumbrance certificate)  

3. Submit application  
   • Fill in the loan application form online or at a branch and upload/submit all required documents (Day 1)  

4. Bank processing (TAT: 10–15 days)  
   • Doc verification & CIBIL check (1–2 days)  
   • Legal due diligence on the property (3–5 days)  
   • Technical valuation by an empanelled valuer (2–3 days)  
   • Credit appraisal & sanction by the committee (2–3 days)  

5. Sanction & disbursement  
   • Receive the sanction letter (around Day 8–12)  
   • Accept terms and execute the Memorandum of Deposit of Title Deeds (1–2 days)  
   • Disbursement of funds in full or in tranches for under-construction properties (Day 10–15)  

If you need more help or want to start your application, please visit your nearest branch or our website.

query: Am I eligible for a home loan?

payload.answer:
To qualify for a Home Loan with us, you must meet our basic eligibility norms in one of these categories:

1. Salaried Individuals  
   • Age at application: 21 years minimum; loan must mature by age 60 (or your retirement age)  
   • Income: at least ₹25,000 pm (metros) or ₹20,000 pm (non-metros)  
   • Work experience: minimum 2 years total, with at least 1 year at your current employer  
   • Credit score: Minimum CIBIL 700 (750+ for best rates)  
   • Employment: Permanent on the payroll of government/PSU/MNC or a reputed private firm  

2. Self-Employed / Business Owners  
   • Age at application: 25 years minimum; loan must mature by age 65  
   • Business vintage: at least 3 years of profitable operations  
   • Income (ITR): Minimum ₹3 lakh per annum  
   • Credit score: Minimum CIBIL 700  
   • Business must be duly registered (and GST-compliant, if applicable)  

3. NRI Applicants  
   • Valid Indian passport plus proof of overseas employment/residence for at least 2 years  
   • NRE/NRO account held for at least 6 months  
   • Must have an Indian resident co-applicant and execute a Power of Attorney for property matters  

If your profile matches one of these sets of criteria, you are eligible to apply.

query: What is the process to open a savings account?

payload.answer:
To open a regular savings account, you need to:

• Be at least 18 years old  
• Submit a valid government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN or Passport)  
• Provide proof of your current address  
• Supply two recent passport-size photographs  
• Deposit the minimum opening balance of INR 1,000 (or INR 10,000 for premium savings)  

Once your KYC documents are verified, the account is activated within 24–48 working hours.

payload.answer:
Here’s a quick guide to our Home Loan offering:

• What it is and how much you can borrow  
  – A secured loan to buy, build, renovate or extend a home, with the property as collateral  
  – Loan amounts from ₹5 lakh up to ₹10 crore (subject to income eligibility and property valuation)  
  – Maximum tenure up to 30 years (or until borrower’s retirement age)  

• How much the bank will finance (LTV)  
  – Up to 90% for homes worth up to ₹30 lakh (you pay 10% down)  
  – Up to 80% for ₹30–75 lakh homes (20% down)  
  – Up to 75% for homes above ₹75 lakh (25% down)  

• Who can apply  
  – Salaried individuals aged 21–60 years, with minimum net income of ₹25,000 (metro) or ₹20,000 (non-metro), 2 years’ work experience and CIBIL ≥700  
  – Self-employed aged 25–65 years, 3 years in business, ITR income ≥₹3 lakh, CIBIL ≥700  

• Costs & charges  
  – Processing fee: 0.5% of loan amount (₹5,000 min, ₹25,000 max) + GST  
  – Legal & technical valuation: ₹5,000–₹15,000  
  – Stamp duty for MODT: 0.1–0.5% of loan  

• How to apply (10–15 day turnaround)  
  1. Submit application + documents online or branch (Day 1)  
  2. Document & CIBIL check (1–2 days)  
  3. Legal and technical property checks (up to 8 days)  
  4. Credit appraisal & sanction (2–3 days)  
  5. Sign sanction letter, complete MODT formalities (1–2 days)  
  6. Disbursement in full or tranches (Day 10–15)  

Let me know if you need details on interest rates, EMIs or required documents!

To open a savings account with us, you need to:

• Be at least 18 years old  
• Submit a valid government-issued ID (Aadhaar, PAN or passport) and proof of address  
• Provide two recent passport-size photographs  
• Deposit the minimum opening balance (INR 1,000 for a regular savings account or INR 10,000 for a premium savings account)  

Once your KYC documents are verified, your account will be activated within 24–48 working hours.

query: tellme  thr process for home loean

payload.answer:
Here’s the typical end-to-end timeline for an Indian home loan (all steps counted from Day 1 of application):  
1. Submit application form plus all required documents (online or at branch) – Day 1  
2. Bank verifies your documents and checks your CIBIL score – 1–2 days  
3. Legal team examines the property title and related papers – 3–5 days  
4. Technical valuation of the property by a bank-empanelled valuer – 2–3 days  
5. Credit appraisal and sanction decision by the bank’s credit committee – 2–3 days  
6. Sanction letter issued to you – typically by Day 8–12  
7. You accept the sanction terms and execute the Memorandum of Deposit of Title Deed (MODT) – 1–2 days  
8. Disbursement of funds (in one go for ready properties or in tranches for under-construction) – by Day 10–15

payload.answer:

• Sale deed or allotment letter  
• Chain of title documents (minimum 13 years)  
• Encumbrance certificate (last 13 years)  
• Approved building plan, occupancy certificate and NOC from society/builder
